versions.content: Selection of applicable RptProfile s The reference Rpt- Container . explicitRptProfileSelection provides a list of RptProfile s which needs to be applied when the RPT support is implemented. If the explicitRptProfileSelection is not defined, all RptProfile s defined in the owing RapidPrototypingScenario are applicable.
